text:
nina: FYI we're planning a conservative tightening of SDK request validation next week. It will cause unknown top-level params to be rejected unless workspaces enable `legacy_param_passthrough`. Not a deprecation but a safety change.

carlos: All SDKs (py/js/go)?

nina: Yes. All official SDKs mirror behavior.

sam: How will this look in logs/errors?

nina: 400 with message like `Unknown parameter: <name>` and a link to migration docs. Well include a small script to find callsites.

docs-bot: Created DOCS-512: migration guide + examples update.

deploy-bot: docs-site: publish succeeded - https://docs.redwood.dev/sdk/param-change (build #5480)

carlos: Timeline + hosting differences?

nina: Timeline: announce now, docs live, feature-flag rollout to staging in 5 days, 30-day hold for existing hosted workspaces. Dedicated/Private will not be auto-flipped; ops can opt in.

sam: Can we get a tiny code sample for enabling the flag?

nina: Short snippets added to the guide; will also ship `redwood-sdk-compat-check` CLI in examples repo.

carlos: I'll draft a customer-facing FAQ and ping legal for copy.

nina: Thanks — drop any edge cases here and we'll add them to the guide.
